name: lookup_crm_account
description: Look up a customer or prospect account in the CRM. Returns company details, contacts, deal history, current pipeline stage, and owner. Use this before giving account-specific advice so answers are based on real data instead of guesses.

query.description: Company name, domain, or CRM account ID to search for.

include_deals.description: Whether to include open and closed deals for the account.

name: get_pipeline_metrics
description: Fetch sales pipeline metrics for a time period, such as pipeline value, win rate, conversion rate by stage, average deal size, and quota attainment. Use this for forecasting, performance reviews, and KPI questions.

start_date.description: Start of the period in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: End of the period in YYYY-MM-DD format.

owner.description: Sales rep or team to filter by. Null returns metrics for the whole org.

name: calculate_quote
description: Calculate a price quote for a deal from the product catalog, applying quantity, billing term, and discount. Returns line items, totals, and whether the discount needs manager approval. Use this instead of estimating prices yourself.

line_items.description: Products to include in the quote.

product_sku.description: SKU of the product from the catalog.

discount_percent.description: Discount to apply, from 0 to 100. Null for list price.
